watches.name: Lumis Day/Night Dial
watches.description: A dial that transitions from day to night — sunrise at 6am, sunset at 6pm. Part of the Riley Studio collection, Lumis is built around a simple idea — showing the transition from day to night on the wrist. The dial is designed to track the movement of time visually, with the sun rising at 6am and setting at 6pm, gradually shifting into night. As the day fades, the lower half of the dial reveals a darker landscape, creating a natural transition from daylight to evening. Each variant explores this concept through different colours and tones — from softer morning light to deeper, warmer finishes — while maintaining a clean, wearable design for everyday use. Powered by a Swiss movement and produced in limited numbers using our trusted manufacturing partners, Lumis sits slightly outside our core collection — a more experimental piece, without compromising on build quality. Specifications Swiss quartz movement (Ronda 515.24H) 38mm stainless steel case 9.25mm thickness 45mm lug-to-lug Multi-layer 3D dial construction K1 mineral crystal 20mm tapering to 18mm leather strap 5ATM water resistance Produced in limited runs — once sold out, this release won’t return.

watches.name: Bessie FAI-01
watches.description: A Tribute to a Pioneer Introducing the Riley Bessie FAI-01 , hand-built in our Manchester workshop. This limited-edition chronograph combines vintage aviation character with a soft, modern colour palette — an elegant nod to the early days of flight and the fearless spirit of its namesake. The Story of Bessie Coleman Bessie Coleman was a trailblazing aviator and the first African American and Native American woman to earn a pilot’s licence. Denied entry to U.S. flight schools because of her race and gender, she travelled to France in 1921 to train with the Fédération Aéronautique Internationale , earning international recognition for her daring air shows and unwavering determination. The Bessie FAI-01 celebrates her courage and legacy, with “Bessie” printed above the date window and a nameplate inspired by the French flight school where she made history. Design & Movement Available in three striking yet refined colourways , the Bessie Aero houses a Japanese Miyota JP21 quartz movement for exceptional accuracy and reliability. Its compact 36 mm case and balanced dial layout feature two primary subdials — one for the day, one for 24-hour time — alongside a framed date window. Every watch is hand-assembled in England and limited to just 100 pieces per colourway . Key Details Movement: Japanese Quartz, Miyota JP21 Case Size: 36 mm Thickness: 9.8 mm Crystal: K1 Heat-Treated Strap: Genuine Leather Water Resistance: 5 ATM Availability Available now for a limited time only!

Its clean dial features prominent numerals and a small seconds subdial for clarity, framed by a slim, strong case built for everyday ruggedness. The Quartz drive means instant precision, zero fuss. Take It with You For the outdoors, the commute, moments of adventure—anywhere you want dependable style without compromise—the Almond Rifleman Field – Quartz is your companion. Built for the Journey Inspired by the functional field watches of the 1940s, the Almond Rifleman Field features military-style numerals and a 24-hour subdial that emphasises utility. It blends Riley’s signature colour flourishes with a strong, purposeful presence — ready for everyday wear or rough terrain. Own Your Field Piece The Almond Rifleman Field is more than just a watch—it’s what you wear when reliability counts, style matters, and heritage inspires. For those who move in all terrains, who value clarity, toughness, and bold colour, this is your instrument.

watches.name: Deco Moon
watches.description: Introducing the Deco Moon A watch that recalls the glamour of the golden age—where dress and daring merged in the skies. The Deco Moon is Riley’s first moonphase complication, a square-Roman inspired piece through which elegance meets aviation’s vintage edge. It’s made for those who want a dress watch with a story. A Statement in Every Detail Ultra-slim, elegantly curved, and square in form, the Deco Moon is made to sit beautifully on the wrist. Its Moonphase display dominates the dial with grace, framed by bold Roman numerals and a case that bridges classic refinement and modern presence. Designed and hand-built in our Manchester workshop, this is watchmaking with both passion and precision. Key Specifications & Features Feature Details Movement Swiss Ronda 708 moonphase — accurate and elegant in function. Case Dimensions 36.5 × 36.0 mm – square profile; approx. 9.6 mm thick – slim and wearable. Crystal Sapphire crystal – clear, resilient, scratch-resistant. Strap Genuine leather strap with 22 mm lug width – comfort and tradition combined. Water Resistance 5 ATM – suitable for everyday wear and light moisture. Colourways Available Cream Dial, Salmon Dial, White Dial. Why the Deco Moon Captivates Vintage Dress with Character – The square-Roman moonphase look echoes the high style of aviation’s golden era, while the strong dial presence ensures it’s no delicate dress piece alone. Elegant Wearability – Its slim case height and curved design make it suitable under cuff or for more formal occasions. It balances boldness with wearable refinement. Swiss Precision & Craftsmanship – Powered by a Swiss movement, built by hand in Manchester—combining local craftsmanship with horological pedigree. Distinctive Aesthetic – The moonphase complication isn’t just functional; it’s the focal point. With Roman numerals and a substantial dial, the Deco Moon commands attention while remaining graceful. The Riley Promise Our Deco Moon is built and shipped from the UK. For US orders, Riley covers the 10% import tariff, so what you pay at checkout is what you receive—no surprises. 30-day hassle-free returns ensure you can confidently judge its fit, feel, and finishing. Own Your Moonlit Moment More than a timepiece, the Deco Moon is an invitation—to dress with intention, to carry heritage, to wear a complication with style. For those who appreciate that elegance is not about distraction but about proportion, poise, and presence, this is your evening signature.

watches.name: Riley Heritage
watches.description: The Heritage, made for every day. The Riley Heritage returns with the same vintage-inspired dial designs and distinctive 1950s character, now powered by an exceptionally dependable Japanese Miyota quartz movement. The result is the slimmest, easiest-wearing Heritage we’ve made — just 9.65mm thick , accurate, reliable and ready to wear whenever you pick it up. And because you’re not paying extra for an automatic movement, we can offer it at a lower price without compromising the part you actually see: the watch itself. Same Heritage. Slimmer Watch. The appeal of the Heritage has always been its design. Its warm colours, railway-style minute track, beautifully proportioned numerals and understated 1950s influence remain at the heart of the watch. The new quartz edition retains that character while allowing us to reduce the case thickness and create a noticeably sleeker watch on the wrist. At 40mm across and only 9.65mm thick , it slips easily under a cuff and feels lighter and less bulky than its automatic predecessor. Inside is the Japanese Miyota 2315 quartz movement — a proven, accurate and low-maintenance movement designed to simply get on with the job. Specifications & Signature Features Feature Detail Movement Japanese Miyota 2315 quartz Function Hours, minutes, seconds and date Case Size 40mm Case Thickness 9.65mm Lug-to-Lug 46mm Crystal Sapphire glass Strap Genuine leather, 20mm tapering to 18mm Water Resistance 5 ATM Caseback Solid stainless-steel caseback Dial Brass dial with the same Heritage design and detailing Built Built in England Why Quartz? There’s a reason quartz transformed watchmaking. It is more accurate than a traditional mechanical movement , requires less maintenance and means you can leave your Heritage for a few days — or a few weeks — and pick it up again without having to reset and wind it. It also allows us to make the Heritage substantially slimmer. So if your priority is the design, quality and character of the watch rather than watching a mechanical rotor turn through the caseback, this is arguably the most usable Heritage we’ve ever made. Same Riley design. Sapphire crystal. Japanese movement. A slimmer case. Greater accuracy. Lower price. That feels like a pretty good trade. Vintage Character Without the Fuss The Heritage was designed to capture something we love about watches from the middle of the twentieth century: they were elegant, colourful and — importantly — wearable. Moving to quartz lets this version get closer to that philosophy. At less than 10mm thick, it has the proportions of a genuinely slim everyday watch while retaining the 40mm presence and unmistakable dial of the original Heritage. Dress it up. Wear it with jeans. Leave it on the bedside table for a fortnight and pick it straight back up. The Heritage is still the Heritage. It’s just easier to live with. The Riley Assurance Every Heritage is built and shipped from the UK and includes our 30-day hassle-free return policy . For customers in the United States, Riley prepays the applicable import tariff, so the price you pay at checkout is the price you pay for the watch — with no unexpected tariff bill when it arrives.

watches.name: Howard Hughes Scarface Chronograph - HH01 SF
watches.description: Please note the original numbered run of this model is sold out, and the currently stocked model uses our updated logo and caseback. Howard Hughes Scarface Chronograph ‒ HH01 SF A cinematic icon reinterpreted. The HH01 SF is not just a timepiece—it’s a statement piece inspired by the glamour, grit, and mythos of Hollywood’s gangster legend. It bridges vintage aviation chronograph aesthetics with the dark elegance of Scarface , offering you more than just time—it gives you presence. From Screen to Wrist When Howard Hughes produced Scarface (1932), he set a tone of ambition, danger, and style. The Scarface Edition takes that cinematic energy, fuses it with the heritage of the Howard Hughes HH01 Chronograph, and finishes it in gold, bold contrast, and exclusive rarity. The result? A striking wristwatch that channels power and luxury in equal measure. Key Features & Specifications Feature Detail Movement Japanese VK64 mecha-quartz – combines mechanical feel with quartz precision. Case Size 40 × 42 mm, stainless steel with gold plating – a presence that commands attention. Thickness Approx. 12 mm – weighty yet balanced in feel. Crystal Sapphire – clear, scratch-resistant, designed to endure. Strap Genuine leather, 22 mm at the lugs — refined but robust. Water Resistance Rated to 5 ATM — safe for everyday moisture, rain, or splashes. What Makes the HH01 SF Exceptional Cinematic Heritage & Style – Crafted to honour both Howard Hughes’ original Scarface and the iconic imagery of its later remakes, this model brings Hollywood intrigue to classic chronograph design. Retro Aviation DNA, Elevated – Uses the base HH01 platform: off-square case, bevelled chronograph inlay, bold dial layout — all reimagined in gold tone, giving it drama and refinement. Versatility in Statement – Whether styled with a classic leather strap or adorned in gold plating, this watch pairs bold luxury with heritage-inspired ruggedness. The Riley Promise Our HH01 Scarface Chronograph is built, shipped, and supported from the UK. Every order comes with fast worldwide shipping and a 30-day hassle-free return policy , ensuring you can wear your piece with confidence. Own a Piece of Legend The HH01 SF is not for the faint of presence—it’s for the bold. It’s for those who appreciate craftsmanship, style, story, and scarcity. If you want a timepiece that’s more than time—one that echoes legacy, ambition, and character—this is the one.

Powered by the Stars Harnessing the sun’s energy, the JC01 uses a Seiko AS01 solar movement, converting daylight into precision, with a power reserve of approximately four months once fully charged. No battery changes, just perpetual motion. Specifications & Signature Details Feature Detail Movement Solar-powered: Seiko AS01 Solar, ensuring consistent, eco-aware performance. Light-Powered Precision — No winding, no battery changes. Just let it see daylight and it keeps going — a timepiece that works in harmony with nature. Wearable Grace — At 38 mm by 9 mm, it combines presence with subtlety — equally at home under a shirt cuff or out during the day. Personality Through Colour — With a dozen striking colourways, the JC01 isn’t just about telling time — it’s about expressing identity. watches.name: Howard Hughes FlyRacer Chronograph
watches.description: Introducing the Howard Hughes FlyRacer Chronograph The Howard Hughes FlyRacer Chronograph takes the aviation spirit of the original Hughes line and gives it a cleaner, sportier edge. With a slimmer 40mm case, tachymeter chapter ring and Seiko VK64 mecha-quartz movement, it’s built for everyday wear with a nod to the golden age of air racing. A Sleeker Sports Chronograph The FlyRacer has a slimmer feel on the wrist than the original Howard Hughes Chronograph, with applied indices, inset sub-dials and a sharp tachymeter scale around the outer dial. It keeps the character of the Hughes collection, but in a more refined, daily-wearable format. Specifications & Key Features Feature Detail Movement Japanese VK64 mecha-quartz — offering the tactile click of mechanical chronograph reset with quartz reliability. Case Diameter 40 mm — an optimal size that pairs presence with polish. Thickness 11 mm — slender enough for daily wear, yet substantial in hand. Crystal Sapphire — scratch-proof and clear. Water Resistance 5 ATM — safe from rain, splashes, and everyday exposure. Strap Genuine leather with dial-matching stitching and quick-release spring bars — comfort, style, and ease. Lug width: 21 mm. Extra Features 24-hour subdial, date display, lume on primary time hands. Design Varieties Available in multiple colour-ways: Classic Retro Cream, Toybox Yellow, Retro Military Green, Midnight Blue, Racing Green, Sky Blue Silver — each with its own distinct palette. Why the FlyRacer Resonates Subtle Sophistication – Its thinner, smaller case softens the silhouette slightly without losing edge: perfect under a cuff or on a weekend outing. Layered Depth – Inset subdials and applied indices give dimensionality; the tachymeter ring adds both function and vintage racing heritage. Precision & Versatility – The mecha-quartz movement provides accuracy, the chronograph and 24-hour complications add utility, and water resistance ensures ruggedness. Character & Colour – With several dial-and-case colour options, the FlyRacer becomes more than a timekeeper; it’s an expression of personal taste. The Riley Assurance Each FlyRacer arrives in a bespoke Riley Watch Co presentation box, backed by a 5-year warranty and a 30-day, no-questions-asked return policy . Every piece is crafted and shipped from the UK, which means what you see is the price you pay—even for international orders. Make a Statement Our FlyRacer is a rare blend of design nuance, mechanical flair, and vintage heart. It’s not just a watch—it’s a refined companion, one that complements both sharp tailoring and everyday journeys.

watches.name: Amelia Earhart - AE01
watches.description: Amelia Earhart Quartz A slimmer, more accurate take on one of Riley’s most distinctive watches. Inspired by Amelia Earhart, the aircraft she flew and the extraordinary era of aviation she helped define, the Amelia Earhart returns with the same striking dial designs in a new, beautifully slim quartz case. At just 9.15mm thick , this is the thinnest and most wearable version we’ve produced — powered by a highly dependable Japanese Miyota quartz movement and protected by sapphire glass. The colours, details and aviation-inspired character remain. The bulk doesn’t. Built Around the Design The Amelia Earhart collection has always been about more than the movement inside it. Canary Yellow references Earhart's first aircraft, The Canary . The vivid red recalls her Lockheed Vega. Silver takes its cues from the aluminium skin of the Electra, while Sky Blue and Classic Cream draw from the visual language of aviation's golden age. Those designs remain the stars of the watch. By moving to a Japanese quartz movement, we've been able to put them into a case measuring just 9.15mm from front to back — creating a watch that feels noticeably lighter, slimmer and more comfortable on the wrist. Specifications & Signature Features Feature Detail Movement Japanese Miyota 2035 quartz Function Hours, minutes and seconds Case Size 40mm Case Thickness 9.15mm Lug-to-Lug 48mm Crystal Sapphire glass Strap Genuine leather, 20mm tapering to 18mm Water Resistance 5 ATM Caseback Solid stainless-steel caseback Dial Brass dial with aviation-inspired detailing Built Built in England Quartz, Deliberately We could have treated quartz as a way to simply make the Amelia Earhart cheaper. We didn't. We chose it because it changes the proportions of the watch. The compact Miyota 2035 allows the complete case to measure only 9.15mm thick. It also gives you the accuracy and convenience quartz is famous for: no winding, no resetting the watch after leaving it unworn and considerably greater timekeeping accuracy than a conventional automatic movement. For an everyday watch, those are real advantages. And because a quality Japanese quartz movement costs less than its mechanical equivalent, you get the same Riley design, sapphire crystal and build quality at a significantly more accessible price. You're paying for the watch you can see and wear — not simply paying more because there's an automatic movement hidden inside it. Same Amelia Earhart. Better Everyday Companion. Put the quartz and automatic editions side by side and the thing you'll notice first isn't the movement. It's the design. The dial, colours, polished details and aviation influence that made the original Amelia Earhart distinctive are all still there. What you gain is a case that's slimmer, a watch that's easier to wear, accuracy you don't have to think about and a lower price. For many owners, we'd argue that makes this the better everyday Amelia Earhart .
